podcast.body: Released in 1990 as a single from the album "Technique," this song led to a successful plagiarism lawsuit by John Denver due to its melodic similarities to his composition "Leaving on a Jet Plane." "New Order and Run, a single from their 1990 album, Technique."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Released in 1990, New Order was sued by John Denver for copyright infringement, as its melody was found to be similar to Denver's "Leaving on a Jet Plane." New Order chose not to fight the lawsuit, resulting in an out-of-court settlement. "New order with run from 1990."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
